subject.title: Plugin UI: add scoped action bridge for sandboxed tabs

question: Should OpenClaw publish and support `sessionActions` plus `allowChatNavigation` as a permanent external plugin SDK capability for sandboxed Control UI tabs?
rationale: This is a new compatibility-sensitive plugin contract and security-boundary expansion, so code review cannot determine its long-term ownership, support, or deprecation policy.

options.title: Approve a narrow bridge contract
options.body: Keep the two explicit capabilities, require Gateway-owned context derivation, and document their stable support and security semantics.

options.title: Defer the external SDK surface
options.body: Keep sandboxed external tabs read-only until a maintainer-sponsored plugin UI capability design is agreed.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow bridge contract
recommendation.body: Keep the two explicit capabilities, require Gateway-owned context derivation, and document their stable support and security semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged gateway-authenticated external-tab boundary that this PR extends.
